thesis: The bull carries current operating evidence through realised growth and high product margin; no new funding failure or order loss is observed. Neutral retains the independent concentration, obligation and entry-value gates rather than extrapolating triple-digit growth. A forward vendor multiple and strong trend cannot substitute for sustainable cash valuation.
strongest_counterexample: Approximately92.5% of revenue is Data Center, making customer financing, guarantees, licensing and capacity constraints concentrated risks; RSI84 and near-high pricing leave little demonstrated timing protection.
invalidation_conditions: A subsequent comparable quarter reports Data Center revenue growth at or below zero or gross margin below the observed75%, undermining the retained demand/product-economics premise and requiring reassessment.
Verified primary evidence of funding/guarantee obligations producing post-investment cash at or below zero would invalidate a cash-sustainable extension of the buy case.
evidence_gaps: Cash conversion, guarantees and customer financing exposures.
Sustainable funded-demand pace and product-specific export restrictions.
decisive_factors: 75% gross margin supports current economics, not through-cycle return proof.
Forward15.14x is an estimate; extreme extension limits immediate entry conviction.
